profile.summary: My intentions are to work in either Information Technology or Software Engineering. I believe that I can & will be an asset to any company that gives me a chance. I can work efficiently as an individual and with others. I also have aspirations to have my own business.

positions.title: Database Developer
positions.locationName: Columbia, South Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Assists DBA with tasks.
• Support information systems areas with database related activities.
• Perform backup and recovery on database management systems (using RedGate software)
• Monitor database environments to identify inefficient and costly paths to data.
• Define data repository requirements data dictionaries, and warehousing requirements. Also build, test, and implement new storage for projects as well as modify existing structures. (Using SQL Server)
• Writes queries & store procedures when needed (in SQL Server

positions.title: Developer
positions.locationName: Columbia, South Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Writing code/debugging for software (with use of Visual Basic, C#, C/C++)
• Data management/manipulation, write stored procedures in PMI Database (SQL).
• Establish reports from data generated weekly/monthly within various databases used in SQL.
• Test code for program functionality (by reviewing/updating existing programs, identifying & fixing defects within code/programs, managing systems’ performance)
• Develop in-house software (i.e. PMI)
• Create/maintain applications (using Visual Studios) to create routine reports.
• Use critical thinking/problem solving skills to help mitigate risk with programs/websites.
• Create web pages for premium information pertaining to groups (using MVC technology)

positions.title: Computer Operator
positions.description:
• Operates, monitors, & troubleshoots computing platforms, systems, hardware devices, and peripheral equipment following established computer procedures.
• Take help desk calls and assists representatives on & off site.
• Uses QicLink to do tasks (change passwords, check cycle, run claims, etc)
• Reviews and follows procedures & documentation in performing job duties.
• Works with I/S (Internet servers) groups to ensure service objectives are met.
• Creates applications to do functions when called on (I have mostly used Visual Basic but I have used C# and Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio to conduct projects as well)

positions.title: Adjunct Professor
positions.description: Taught math & computer sciences courses using different methodologies. Math classes included Algebra, Pre-Cal/Trigonometry
